page_title: NIC 2-1 HAV | Nice v Le Havre 07/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's it for today, Francois Letexier has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Evann Guessand (Nice) has tested the patience of referee Francois Letexier and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

90+2' 2 - 1 Goal! The ball is swung into the box from the resulting corner kick and finds Gautier Lloris (Le Havre), who jumps highest and tries his luck with a header from around the penalty spot. His effort is both strong and precise enough to go inside the left post. The score changes to 2:1.
90+2' Le Havre get a corner.
90+1' A corner kick by Le Havre is thwarted by the well prepared Marcin Bulka (Nice). Le Havre have been awarded a corner kick.
90+1' Le Havre fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
89' A substitution has been made. Tanguy Ndombele is replaced by Issiaga Camara (Nice).
89' Franck Haise decides to make a substitution. Gaetan Laborde will be replaced by Youssoufa Moukoko (Nice).
88' Timothee Pembele (Le Havre) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ilyes Housni (Le Havre) will replace Steve Ngoura.
87' Here is a change. Oussama Targhalline is going off and Didier Digard gives the last tactical orders to Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre).
86' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Tanguy Ndombele (Nice) was quite harsh and Francois Letexier didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
84' A cross from a corner kick by Nice is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
83' The goalkeeper is not tested by the free kick from the edge of the box by Sofiane Diop (Nice) as his effort only hit the wall.
82' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
79' Here comes a substitution. Badredine Bouanani is given a rest as he is replaced by Jeremie Boga (Nice).

79' Etienne Youte Kinkoue (Le Havre) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.
79' Le Havre take a quick free kick with a short pass and play continues.
78' Francois Letexier couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Tanguy Ndombele (Nice) and blew his whistle. Le Havre have a free kick from a promising distance.
77' Le Havre work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

77' Oussama Targhalline (Le Havre) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball goes behind for a corner. Le Havre will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
75' 2 - 0 Goal! Badredine Bouanani (Nice) neatly controls a decent pass from Gaetan Laborde. He looks up and smashes an unstoppable drive into the bottom right corner from the edge of the box. 2:0.
74' Wonderful movement by Le Havre. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
72' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) is penalised for a foul. Francois Letexier had a clear view and blows his whistle.
71' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
69' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
67' The game has come to an end for Yassine Kechta. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Andre Ayew (Le Havre).
67' Didier Digard prepares a substitution. Rassoul Ndiaye is replaced by Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre).
65' Evann Guessand (Nice) zig-zags his way into the box and fires the ball towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a great reaction save to stop the effort.
64' Francois Letexier shows a yellow card to Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) for his blatant foul.
63' Yael Nandjou has picked up an injury and is replaced by Amidou Doumbouya (Nice).
62' Looks like Yael Nandjou (Nice) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

60' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.
58' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Nice comes to nothing.
57' A cross into the box from Oussama Targhalline (Le Havre) is cleared.
55' 1 - 0 Goal! Gaetan Laborde (Nice) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Arthur Desmas.
54' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) is going to take the penalty!
53' It’s a PENALTY to Nice after the VAR review!
53' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Nice! Let's see what he decides.
52' Yoann Salmier (Le Havre) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
52' Nice are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
50' Tanguy Ndombele (Nice) fires a shot well wide of the left post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
49' Steve Ngoura (Le Havre) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.

44' Badredine Bouanani (Nice) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the left post by a whisker. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
42' Le Havre are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
41' Badredine Bouanani (Nice) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
39' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
39' Le Havre will take a corner kick.
38' Wow, what an escape. Steve Ngoura (Le Havre) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. Le Havre have a corner.
38' 3:4 – the total goal attempt statistics.
35' That was absolutely fantastic! Tom Louchet (Nice) tries his luck with a hammer shot from long range, but his effort only rattles the crossbar! Here is an example of luck not being on your side.
35' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Nice, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
34' Oussama Targhalline (Le Havre) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. A free kick has been awarded to Nice.
33' Tanguy Ndombele (Nice) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
30' The corner is swung in but Le Havre can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
29' Steve Ngoura (Le Havre) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.

24' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Le Havre are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
22' Nice can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
21' Nice take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

20' Nice fail to score from a corner as Arthur Desmas (Le Havre) leaps to collect the ball. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Nice will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
20' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Badredine Bouanani (Nice). The ball is out of play. Nice win a corner kick.
15' The ball possession is 53:47.
12' Yoann Salmier (Le Havre) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
12' The ball goes out of play. Le Havre are awarded a corner kick.
7' Francois Letexier interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Yael Nandjou (Nice).
4' Le Havre take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
3' Oussama Targhalline (Le Havre) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The ball has crossed the sideline. Le Havre are taking a throw-in.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Nice will kick the game off.
Francois Letexier will officiate today.
Show lineups Both teams starting lineups are available now, so you can have a look at them.
